answer:
Análisis principal completado sobre los 5 bins raw (3400–3000 BCE). Resumen de resultados y hipótesis final.

## Resultados (n = 5, 100-yr bins; CI 95% por Fisher z)

| Outcome | Predictor | Pearson r (p) | 95% CI | Spearman ρ (p) | Predictor std |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| MonumentCount | Zhausgr | −0.352 (0.562) | [−0.94, 0.77] | −0.410 (0.493) | 0.816 |
| MonumentCount | ZAxtSchwert | 0.285 (0.642) | [−0.80, 0.93] | 0.354 (0.559) | 0.0045 |
| MonumentCount | ZDolch | **undefined** (const −0.58) | — | — | 0.000 |
| MonumentCount | ZHort (cross-check) | 0.852 (0.067) | [−0.12, 0.99] | 0.821 (0.089) | 0.063 |
| AxesCelts | Zhausgr | −0.166 (0.789) | [−0.91, 0.84] | −0.368 (0.542) | 0.816 |
| AxesCelts | ZAxtSchwert | −0.106 (0.865) | [−0.90, 0.86] | 0.181 (0.770) | 0.0045 |
| AxesCelts | ZDolch | **undefined** (const −0.58) | — | — | 0.000 |
| AxesCelts | ZHort (cross-check) | 0.930 (0.022) | [0.27, 1.00] | 0.895 (0.040) | 0.063 |

**Honestía sobre n=5:** ningún CI excluye valores cercanos a cero salvo el límite superior de AxesCelts~ZHort; ningún resultado puede interpretarse como significancia robusta. OLS `MonumentCount ~ 1 + HouseSize + HatchetSword`: R²=0.135, adj R²=−0.730, F p=0.865 — ningún término significativo (HatchetSword con std 0.0045 hace su coeficiente inestable). Sensibilidad con la grilla anual `_inter` (n=401, autocorrelacionada = pseudo-replicación): Mon~Hausgr r=−0.404 vs −0.352 en bins — misma señal, n inflado artificialmente.

**Varianza dentro de la ventana:** Dagger (ZDolch) es constante (−0.58) y HatchetSword (ZAxtSchwert) prácticamente constante (−0.43…−0.42, std 0.0045): **no aportan varianza en esta ventana, por lo que la señal de "symbolic capital" la lleva efectivamente HouseSize (Zhausgr)**, con Depot (ZHort) como cross-check.

**Contexto openness (no incluido en el modelo core):** pollen SMOOTH_MEAN_100y cae de forma sostenida a través de la ventana (0.20 → 0.32 → −0.58 → −0.80 → −1.81), un factor demográfico/ambiental que podría co-variar con todos los indicadores.

## Hipótesis final (direccional y cautelosa)

> Between 3400 and 3000 BCE, the number of monuments and the number of axes do **not** show a systematic positive co-variation with the measured elements of symbolic capital. Of the three symbolic-capital indicators, only house size (Zhausgr) varies at all in this window — dagger is constant and hatchet-sword near-constant — and the observable trend is *weakly negative*: the MonumentCount peak at 3200 BCE coincides with house size declining from its 3400 BCE high (r ≈ −0.35, n = 5, 95% CI spanning zero), while AxesCelts shows no meaningful association with any symbolic-capital variable. The strongest co-variation in the window is instead with depots (ZHort: r ≈ 0.85 for monuments, ≈ 0.93 for axes), suggesting that the 3200 BCE monument-building and axe-production peak was accompanied by — rather than driven by — the symbolic-capital indicators as measured, and was set against a backdrop of steadily decreasing landscape openness (pollen). Given n = 5, this is a directional tendency, not a statistically established relationship.

**Limitaciones:** n=5; Z-scores estandarizados globalmente (no por ventana); MonumentCount clasificado como Social Capital en las notas del estudio pero tratado como outcome aquí siguiendo la formulación de la pregunta; interpolación lineal verificada exacta pero no utilizada en el análisis core; pollen solo como contexto.

Only house size (Zhausgr) varies within the window (dagger constant, hatchet-sword near-constant), and the observable trend is weakly negative: the MonumentCount peak at 3200 BCE coincides with house size declining from its 3400 BCE high (r ≈ -0.35, n = 5, 95% CI spanning zero), while AxesCelts shows no meaningful association with any symbolic-capital variable. The strongest co-variation is instead with depots (ZHort: r ≈ 0.85 for monuments, ≈ 0.93 for axes), set against a backdrop of steadily decreasing landscape openness (pollen SMOOTH_MEAN_100y from +0.20 to -1.81). payload.workflow: 1) Loaded data/time_series_data.csv (annual grid, CE -4100..-500) and data/capital.csv (100-yr bins, decimal-comma); asserted the two files agree exactly on all 5 bins x 6 variables. 2) Extracted the 3400-3000 BCE window: 5 raw 100-yr bins (BCE 3400, 3300, 3200, 3100, 3000); the _inter columns were verified to be exact linear interpolation and used only as a sensitivity check (annual n=401 grid = pseudo-replication). 3) Computed Pearson and Spearman correlations of MonumentCount and AxesCelts against Zhausgr, ZAxtSchwert, ZDolch, plus ZHort as cross-check, with 95% CIs via Fisher z transformation. 4) Fitted OLS MonumentCount ~ 1 + HouseSize + HatchetSword (ZDolch excluded: zero in-window variance). 5) Checked pollen openness (Belau/Woserin SMOOTH_MEAN_100y) in-window as demographic context only, not in the core model. 6) Wrote a directional, non-significance-claiming hypothesis.
